Arc Hits 168,000 Wallets in First 24 Hours

Circle's Arc went public on September 16 and pulled 167.6K active wallets on day one – 12x the 13.9K from the day before, when the chain was still in private mainnet with ~100 institutional builders.

What sets this launch apart: gas is paid in USDC, and the validators are BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, Mastercard and ICE rather than crypto node operators. Day-one access came via Binance Wallet, OKX, MetaMask and Kraken, with Aave, Morpho and Uniswap live from the start.

With no native token and dollar-denominated fees, the airdrop crowd has little reason to show up – so if the count holds through the week, it's real demand.

Inspired by 🔗 @randgroup

tweet.text:
Airdrop is Dead. 💯

We’ve made the difficult decision to pause our blockchain development indefinitely.

A major factor behind this decision has been the lack of meaningful community participation and the overwhelming presence of bad actors within the airdrop campaign.

We recorded over 2 million requests across our faucets and testnet within a very short period. The resulting surge in backend infrastructure usage created thousands of dollars in unexpected infrastructure costs, largely driven by repeated and low-value actions from participants.

At this point, the cost of sustaining these activities is no longer justifiable, especially when genuine community contribution has been far below expectations.

This isn’t the outcome we wanted, but we believe transparency is important.

Thank you to everyone who genuinely supported, contributed, tested, and believed in what we were building. ❤️

We appreciate your understanding.
